rejected_rule.statement: A defendant claiming prescriptive rights to a portion of land must identify the portion and establish prescription to the said portion as required by law, either to claim title or seek a dismissal of a plaintiff's action in relation to that specific portion of land.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In a rei vindicatio suit, it is necessary for a person who is claiming title to a land to establish his title as well as the identity of the corpus of the action. Similarly in my view, when a defendant is claiming prescriptive rights to a portion of land where a plaintiff has proved his paper title and identity, it was up to the said defendant to identify the portion where he claims prescription and establish prescription to the said portion as required by law, either to claim title or even to seek a dismissal of a plaintiff’s action in relation to that specific portion of land.
